stages.output: Analyze questionnaire answers, plan emotional approaches, discover the closing thesis, and draft 5-7 dramatic beats.
Generate 4K multi-character lineup sheets and hero prop continuity sheets with Nano Banana 2.1 via Google Flow.
Generate 16:9 3D environment plates with storybook lighting and camera depth of field.
Draw 8-panel native 16:9 storyboard direct-plate sheets locking camera movements and staging.
Compile prompts into Seedance 2.5 with emergent native dialogue, acoustic ambience, and Foley.
Upscale clips to 1080p via Modal SeedVR2 H100 and losslessly concatenate into master-movie.mp4 with 9-frame dailies.
